claim: The mainline one-player start state ST1 loads the STATUS word — the df7 phase machine's attract->setup start edge (ST1 *ONE PLAYER START).
The mainline two-player start state ST2 loads the STATUS word — the 2P alternating start (df7 Decision D; ST2 *TWO PLAYER START).
HALDIS is the attract / hall-of-fame display routine the cabinet returns to (reached by HALL13 JMP HALDIS 'ATTRACT MODE NOW', AMODE1.SRC:230) — the df7 game-over->attract loop close.

source.verbatim: HALDIS	CLR	HSRFLG	CLEAR HIGH SCORE RESET FLAG

claim: GAMEOV is the GAME OVER routine the play->game-over edge routes to (the df5-6 isGameOver men<0 condition, consumed not re-decided).

source.verbatim: GAMEOV	ORCC	#$90	SET TO COMPR/NOT AUTO CYCLE

claim: HALL13 jumps to HALDIS to (re)enter attract mode — proof that HALDIS is the attract-mode display, the cabinet's game-over->attract return.

source.verbatim: HALL13	JMP	HALDIS	ATTRACT MODE NOW
